decision.reason: The release note and PR [ev-c54ac338953d][ev-6179140006bb] say only that `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` was promoted to Beta. They do not say whether the gate is now enabled by default or how finalizer handling changes for an environment that does nothing. The PR touched the Helm values and features.go files [ev-fe5209e3501f], but the excerpt lists only file names, not the default. By contrast, the neighbouring NameConstraints note says "(enabled by default)" explicitly [ev-619c0cea3aa4]. The proposed statement ("more widely available for use in production") is not in the evidence. Deciding between behavior-change and none needs the new default in features.go/values.yaml and a description of the finalizer change.
